label: Locally surface-anchored CCO portal tree grown from public portal15_1 seed

assumptions.method: binary CCO, volume-optimized jittered bifurcations, grown as 5 spatial territories, extended by coverage-driven adaptive growth (targets the worst-covered tissue directly rather than a fixed terminal count or reactive edge-length patching), followed by long-tail densification (any unbranched leaf reach over the short-reach length cap is recursively bisected with a real side-branch child at each split, so long bare reaches resolve into multiple generations of bifurcation rather than staying as a single long unbranched segment)
assumptions.centrelineMethod: cubic Hermite per element (blend=0.4, 8 render/quadrature samples); root derivative seeded from the observed truncated tree measured tangent
assumptions.coverageMethod: Monte Carlo tissue sampling (3000 pts/iteration); target 92% of tissue within 7.0mm of a vessel; worst-covered points (min separation 2.5mm) added in batches of up to 25 per iteration
assumptions.boundaryTargetMethod: 15% of initial targets sampled inside a 2.5mm surface shell so distal terminals reach the liver boundary
assumptions.geometricConstraints: length>2x radius (all 3 segments), new-segment length<50x its radius, weak orientation sign checks, daughter radius ratio r_new/r_continuation>=0.3, radius-proportional clearance (>5x radius), distance-to-organ-skin length cap, perpendicular bifurcation jitter (non-collinear splits)
assumptions.surfaceTerminalAnchoring: 809 leaf endpoints already within 8.0 mm of the surface moved along validated interior segments to 0.75 mm inside the liver surface; long interior leaves were not pulled radially outward
assumptions.interpretation: CCO growth is seeded from the public portal asset; only leaves already within 8 mm of the surface are locally anchored, avoiding long radial terminal spokes.
